comment: Input index 4 is RECALL_INPUT (StepStation.cpp:394) and is the one port in this plugin given no configInput name, so Rack's tooltip for it is empty; it sits under the RECL label and works as that button does. The U1 and U2 jacks and knobs get no family and no range because their meaning is set per track from a menu: the same jack can be a gate, a 0-10V level or nothing at all. Props are recorded once for each group of eight identical per-track ports. The step knobs, the LEN knobs and the U1/U2 knobs are ordinary parameters and can each be clicked; the MOD and track-number displays are custom widgets with no ParamWidget, so the menus they carry cannot be reached by clicking them for help.
